title: AG60002: Alternative Energy Sources
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Solar system. Design of solar energy operated systems for heating, cooling,
distillation, drying, dehydration, water pumping and power generation for
application in agriculture. Photo voltaic devices. Utilization of wind energy
for generation of electricity and mechanical power. Types of wind mills and
their characteristics. Mechanics of wind mills. Design of wind mills. Recycling
of agricultural waste. Microbial conversion of plant materials to fuel. Biochemistry of anaerobic fermentation of bio-mass. Design of biogas systems for
heating, lighting and running IC engines. Economics of biogas utilization. Biofuels.
